Company Human Resources Policy
Version: 2026.3
Effective date: February 1, 2026

Performance Reviews
The company runs a formal performance review cycle once each calendar year. Managers are expected to conduct a review conversation with each direct report during the annual cycle.

New employees may receive an additional introductory review during their first six months.

Remote Work
Eligible employees may work remotely up to three days per week, subject to team requirements and manager approval.

Employee Records
Employees should keep their personal contact and emergency information current in the HR system.

Employee Health Insurance Policy
Version: 2026.1
Effective date: January 1, 2026

Medical Plan
The standard employee medical plan has an annual in-network individual deductible of USD 1,500. The family deductible is USD 3,000.

Preventive care is covered according to the plan's preventive-care provisions. Employees should review the plan summary for specific covered services.

Enrollment
New employees generally have 30 days from their employment start date to complete benefits enrollment.

Company IT and Security Policy
Version: 2026.4
Effective date: April 1, 2026

Password Requirements
Employees must change their corporate password at least once every 90 days when the identity platform requires password rotation. Passwords must not be reused across unrelated personal services.

Multi-Factor Authentication
Multi-factor authentication is required for corporate applications that support it.

Lost or Stolen Devices
If a company laptop or mobile device is lost or stolen, the employee must immediately contact the IT Service Desk and Security team. The company may remotely lock or wipe managed devices.

Phishing
Employees must report suspected phishing messages through the company's security reporting mechanism and must not enter corporate credentials into suspicious links or

Access
Employees must only access systems and documents necessary for their job responsibilities.

Company Leave Policy
Version: 2026.2
Effective date: January 1, 2026

Parental Leave
Eligible full-time employees receive 16 weeks of paid parental leave following the birth or legal adoption of a child. The leave may be taken continuously or, subject to manager approval and applicable law, in separate blocks.

Employees should notify their manager and Human Resources at least 30 days before a planned leave when reasonably possible. In unexpected circumstances, notice should be provided as soon as practical.

Parental leave is separate from the standard annual leave balance. Employees should contact Human Resources for questions about eligibility, documentation, or coordination with other legally protected leave.

Sick Leave
Employees receive 12 paid sick days per calendar year.

Sick Leave
Employees receive 12 paid sick days per calendar year.

Annual Leave
Employees receive 20 days of paid annual leave per calendar year.

Company Travel and Expense Policy
Version: 2026.1
Effective date: March 1, 2026

Flights
Economy class is the standard class for domestic travel and international trips of less than six hours. Business class may be approved for international travel exceeding six hours when required by business needs.

Hotels
The standard reimbursement limit for hotel accommodation is USD 180 per night before applicable taxes. Exceptions require advance approval from the employee's department head.

Meals
Employees traveling for business may claim up to USD 60 per day for meals. Individual meal receipts should be retained where required by the expense system.

Ground Transportation
Reasonable taxi, rideshare, rail, and public transportation expenses are reimbursable when incurred for business travel.

Expense Submission
